newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEC wins 35 bln yen Egyptian ethylene plant order.
newsitem.headline: TEC wins 35 bln yen Egyptian ethylene plant order.

text.p: Toyo Engineering Corp (TEC) said on Tuesday it had won a 35 billion yen order from Egypt to build the country's first ethylene plant, with annual capacity of 300,000 tonnes.
Under the turn-key contract with Egypt's state-run oil firm Egyptian General Petroleum Corp, TEC is responsible for engineering, procurement and construction, a company spokesman said.
Construction of the project, to be located in Alexandria, is scheduled for completion by the end of 1999.
The plant will be the second ethylene centre in Africa following one in Algeria, also built by TEC in the mid-1970s, the spokesman said.
Trading house Marubeni Corp worked closely with TEC on the Egyptian contract, he added.
